ns2:course.label: Food Processing I
ns2:course.description: Principles, unit operations, and applications of food preservation and processing; includes heat transfer, chemical and microbial inactivation kinetics, chemical and microbial changes in processed foods, freezing, refrigeration, evaporation, dehydration, freeze-concentration, membrane processing, extrusion and water activity control; lectures. Prerequisite: FSHN 418 and FSHN 460; FSHN 414 or equivalent; FSHN 260 is recommended.
